keyEvents.text: Luis Valadez (León) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! León 0, Cruz Azul 1. José Paradela (Cruz Azul) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Agustín Palavecino.
Goal! León 0, Cruz Azul 2. Nicolás Ibáñez (Cruz Azul) right footed shot from outside the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Carlos Rodríguez.
Jeremy Márquez (Cruz Azul) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Fernando Beltrán (León).
Gonzalo Piovi (Cruz Azul) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, León 0, Cruz Azul 2.
Substitution, León. Iván Rodríguez replaces Luis Valadez.
Substitution, León. Alfonso Alvarado replaces Ismael Díaz.
Substitution, León. Juan Domínguez replaces Fernando Beltrán.
Delay in match because of an injury Andrés Gudiño (Cruz Azul).
Substitution, León. Edgar Guerra replaces Iván Moreno.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Cruz Azul. Andrés Montaño replaces Érik Lira.
Substitution, Cruz Azul. Carlos Rotondi replaces Carlos Rodríguez.
Substitution, Cruz Azul. Alan Mozo replaces Jeremy Márquez.
Substitution, Cruz Azul. Gabriel Fernández replaces Nicolás Ibáñez.
Goal! León 0, Cruz Azul 3. José Paradela (Cruz Azul) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Agustín Palavecino with a through ball.
Delay in match because of an injury José Paradela (Cruz Azul).
Delay in match (León).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! León 0, Cruz Azul 4. Gabriel Fernández (Cruz Azul) right footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the top left corner.
Substitution, León. Jordi Cortizo replaces Rodrigo Echeverría.
Substitution, Cruz Azul. Ralph Orquin replaces Jesús Orozco because of an injury.
Second Half ends, León 0, Cruz Azul 4.
